questions.title: What should make it fire?
questions.text: Positions dip below safety stock every week and most have an order landing in time. The rule can fire only when something will run short before it can be replenished, or on every position below safety stock.

tiles.t: When a position will run short before its next receipt
Also when an outage reservation is not covered 14 days ahead
tiles.s: What the standard asks for outages

questions.title: Who is told when it fires?
questions.text: No storeroom list is connected. The note goes out without waiting for you, so pick who should see it.

tiles.t: Me, the buyers and the site leads
tiles.s: Everyone who can release or move stock

nodes.title: Confirm what the load flagged, and size it
nodes.purpose: Which positions will run short before they can be replenished, and by how much.
nodes.how: Every critical position against its safety stock, its reservations and its next confirmed receipt: on hand, what is needed by when, the shortfall. Limited to the positions in the load that fired the rule.
nodes.check: Every flagged position recomputes from on hand, safety stock, reservations and promised dates.

nodes.title: Why it happened, and whether anyone is on it
nodes.purpose: Is this new, and is someone already handling it.
nodes.how: Supplier date changes, released reservations, the Corrigan allocation, and what the buyers, the outage manager and the plants have said.
draws: Outlook: outage, buyers, plants (R1, R2, F2)
nodes.check: Every cause is dated and sourced.

nodes.title: Look across the group: stock, expedites, substitutes
nodes.purpose: What the rest of the group holds, and what the suppliers can still do.
nodes.how: For each position: other sites holding the same material above their own safety stock, the freight to move it, expedites the suppliers have offered, and approved substitutes.
nodes.check: No holder is taken below its own safety stock.

nodes.title: What can still be done, including nothing
nodes.purpose: Each course of action with what it costs and what it protects, checked against open goals.
nodes.how: Each option with its cost, the positions it covers, the days of outage it protects, who has to agree, and an honest statement where nothing can be done in time; read the open goals on this role.
nodes.check: Every option states what it costs and what it covers.

nodes.title: Build the deliverables, act and tell you
nodes.purpose: Build what was agreed at set-up, take the actions that run by themselves, hold the others for your OK, and tell the people you chose.
nodes.how: The positions, why they are short, what the group holds, the options and the moves; on the stock exception note template.
nodes.check: Every figure in the note links back to its step.
